grammar_title: 名词性从句复习:宾语从句 · 主语/表语从句 · 同位语从句(连接词的选择)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 2 Discover useful structures:名词性从句复习。句子地道、留学/文化交流主题,每空只一个连接词成立(that 只连接不充当成分;what 充当成分;宾语从句 if=whether,但句首/介词后/同位语只用 whether;同位语 that 不可省且不作成分,区别定语从句 which/that 作成分)。

points.point: 宾语从句(that / whether / if / what 等)
points.overview: 动词或介词后接宾语从句:陈述完整内容用 that;表'是否'用 whether/if(介词后只用 whether);从句缺成分(主/宾)用 what。

points.point: 主语从句 & 表语从句(What… / It… that… / The fact is that…)
points.overview: 主语从句:从句缺成分用 What,完整内容用 that(或形式主语 It is… that…);表语从句:在 be 后用 that(完整)或 what(缺成分)。
抽象名词(fact/idea/news/question 等)后解释其内容用 that(不可省、不作成分);表'是否'用 whether;与定语从句区别:同位语 that 不作成分,定语从句 which/that 在从句中作主语或宾语。

questions.stem: Xie Lei said ____ she felt much more at home in the UK now.
questions.explanation: said 后接陈述内容、从句完整不缺成分 → that(只连接不充当成分)。

questions.stem: I don't know ____ the exchange student will come to our class.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、句意未定 → whether(that 表确定陈述,此处不合)。

questions.stem: Please tell me ____ you need before you go abroad.
questions.explanation: tell me 后宾语从句缺 need 的宾语 → what(充当宾语;that 不作成分)。

questions.stem: At first she had no idea about ____ she should say in class.
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后从句缺 say 的宾语 → what;介词后不用 that/if。

questions.stem: Her tutor explained ____ she must acknowledge other people's ideas.
questions.explanation: explained 后陈述内容、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The advisor asked ____ the students had any worries about going abroad.
questions.explanation: asked 表'是否有'、未定 → whether(if 此处也行,但选项中只 whether 合且无 if)。

questions.stem: Xie Lei was surprised at ____ the British people thought of Chinese culture.
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后从句缺 thought of 的宾语 → what;介词后不用 if/that。

questions.stem: Leon couldn't believe ____ many kinds of Chinese food there are.
questions.explanation: 感叹'有多么多'、修饰 many → how;此处非'是否'也非缺名词成分。

questions.stem: The host family told Xie Lei ____ they were keen to learn about China.
questions.explanation: told 后陈述内容、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: She wondered ____ she should stick to her own way or follow the local way.
questions.explanation: wondered + 二选一'是否……还是' → whether(常与 or 连用;that 不表选择)。

questions.stem: Studying abroad changed ____ Xie Lei thought about the wider world.
questions.explanation: changed 后从句表'方式'、缺方式状语 → how(非'是否',非缺名词成分)。

questions.stem: The interviewer asked the student ____ had impressed her most in China.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺主语 → what(充当主语;that 不作成分)。

questions.stem: I think ____ getting involved in activities is the best way to fit in.
questions.explanation: think 后陈述内容、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: Aisha was not sure ____ learning Chinese would help her future career.
questions.explanation: be not sure 表'是否'、未定 → whether。

questions.stem: Now she finally understood ____ her tutor had really wanted to say.
questions.explanation: understood 后从句缺 say 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: He often thinks about ____ his life would be like without his Chinese friends.
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后从句缺 be like 的表语 → what;介词后不用 if/that。

questions.stem: Wang Li believes ____ studying in China can help families save money.
questions.explanation: believes 后陈述内容、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us ____ we had ever suffered from culture shock.
questions.explanation: asked + '是否曾经' → whether(if 此处也可,但选项中只 whether 合且无 if)。

questions.stem: Cooperating with others taught her ____ a global mind really means.
questions.explanation: taught her 后从句缺 means 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: Listen carefully and decide ____ the conversation is probably happening.
questions.explanation: decide 后从句表'地点'、缺地点状语 → where(非陈述完整,故非 that)。

questions.stem: ____ surprised Xie Lei was that she soon began speaking up in class.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 surprised 的主语 → What(充当主语;that 不作成分)。

questions.stem: ____ Xie Lei keeps a balance between study and social life is important.
questions.explanation: 主语从句内容完整、不缺成分 → That(只连接)。

questions.stem: It surprised everyone ____ she felt at home in the UK so quickly.
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It…，真主语从句完整 → that(It…that… 结构)。

questions.stem: ____ impressed Leon first was the wonderful Chinese food.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 impressed 的主语 → What。

questions.stem: ____ he should study abroad or stay in China is still undecided.
questions.explanation: 主语从句表'是否……还是'、句首 → Whether(句首不用 if)。

questions.stem: The truth is ____ getting involved in activities helps you overcome culture shock.
questions.explanation: 表语从句内容完整、不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: ____ Aisha said about Ms Hu's family moved everyone in the room.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 said 的宾语 → What。

questions.stem: The fact is ____ tuition fees abroad are much higher than at home.
questions.explanation: 表语从句内容完整 → that。

questions.stem: It is clear ____ exposure to another culture broadens students' minds.
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It is clear…，真主语从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ seemed strange to Xie Lei before now appears quite normal.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 seemed 的主语 → What。

questions.stem: Her biggest worry was ____ she could make friends in a new country.
questions.explanation: 表语从句表'是否'、未定 → whether。

questions.stem: ____ the host family loved most was Xie Lei's stir-fried tomatoes and eggs.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 loved 的宾语 → What。

questions.stem: It remains to be seen ____ her research paper will be well received.
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It…，真主语表'是否'、未定 → whether(不用 that/if)。

questions.stem: His ambition is ____ he will set up a successful business one day.
questions.explanation: 表语从句内容完整、不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: ____ made Aisha want to become a teacher was Ms Hu's warm care.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 made 的主语 → What。

questions.stem: ____ studying abroad is worthwhile depends on each student's situation.
questions.explanation: 主语从句表'是否'、句首 → Whether(句首不用 if;非缺成分,故非 What)。

questions.stem: The good news is ____ her presentation on Chinese art was a great success.
questions.explanation: 表语从句内容完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ really motivated Leon was the kindness of the Chinese people.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 motivated 的主语 → What。

questions.stem: It is no surprise ____ many students suffer from homesickness at first.
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It is no surprise…，真主语完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ a student adapts to a new culture often decides how happy they feel.
questions.explanation: 主语从句表'方式/程度'、缺方式状语 → How(非缺名词成分,故非 What)。

questions.stem: The fact ____ studying abroad has disadvantages cannot be denied.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 fact 的内容、从句完整 → that(不可省、不作成分;which 须在从句作成分)。

questions.stem: She kept the idea ____ cultural exchange could build bridges between nations.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 idea 的内容、从句完整 → that(which 不引导同位语从句)。

questions.stem: We received the news ____ Xie Lei's exchange year had been a great success.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 news 的内容、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The question ____ she should live with a host family troubled her for days.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句表'是否'解释 question → whether(question + whether;不用 if 引导同位语)。

questions.stem: He could not accept the fact ____ his classmates spoke so fast.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 fact、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The belief ____ hard work brings success kept the students going.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 belief、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: I like the idea ____ China should tell its own stories to the world.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 idea、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The question ____ to study abroad or not is one many families discuss.
questions.explanation: 同位语 + 不定式'是否……' → whether(whether to do;不用 if to do)。

questions.stem: There is growing hope ____ more young people will become cultural envoys.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 hope、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The advice ____ she should read widely helped her form her own opinions.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 advice、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The fact ____ she shared during the interview moved the whole audience.
questions.explanation: 此处从句缺 shared 的宾语 → 是定语从句,关系代词 that 在从句作宾语(对比同位语 that 不作成分)。

questions.stem: He raised the question ____ cashless payment had changed daily life in China.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句表'是否'解释 question → whether。

questions.stem: The idea ____ she first proposed was to start a Chinese culture club.
questions.explanation: 此处从句缺 proposed 的宾语 → 定语从句,that 在从句作宾语(非同位语,因从句缺成分)。

questions.stem: We must face the fact ____ adapting to a new culture is never easy.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 fact、从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The news ____ surprised the students was that the institute had grown so fast.
questions.explanation: 此处从句缺 surprised 的主语 → 定语从句,that 在从句作主语(对比同位语 that 不作成分)。

questions.stem: His doubt ____ he could pass the course slowly disappeared over time.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 doubt、从句完整 → that(doubt 在肯定语境后常用 that)。

questions.stem: There remains the question ____ studying abroad is worth such a high cost.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句表'是否'解释 question → whether。

questions.stem: The suggestion ____ students keep reasonable expectations is very helpful.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 suggestion、从句完整(虚拟 keep)→ that。

questions.stem: The discovery ____ she made about herself was that she could speak up.
questions.explanation: 此处从句缺 made 的宾语 → 定语从句,that 在从句作宾语(非同位语)。

questions.stem: We share the hope ____ the world can be brought closer together.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释 hope、从句完整 → that。
